notes.text: Played on Magic Online on 11 December 2022 (09:00 UTC), "hosted for the European region" but open to all accounts. Placings and seeds are from the MTGO bracket; players are MTGO account names.
MTGO lists a card once per printing (e.g. 2 Tundra and 1 Tundra); such rows are combined here.
Archetype names are MTGGoldfish's, for consistency across events.
Identified as Julian Jakobovits (USA) by the magiclibrarities prize-painting index.
MTGO name of Franco Cicchini, the Eternal Weekend Europe 2025 winner.
